Scraping¶

class src.scrape.GradCafeScraper¶

Capture and parse publicly available GradCafe admissions results.

capture_current_page() → tuple[str, str]¶

Capture HTML from the active GradCafe results page.

get_current_url() → str¶

Return the URL of the active Google Chrome tab.

get_next_url(html: str) → str | None¶

Find the next GradCafe results-page URL.

navigate_to(url: str) → None¶

Navigate Chrome to a GradCafe results page.

scrape_data(html: str) → list[dict]¶

Parse applicant records from one GradCafe results page.

wait_for_results(timeout: int = 60) → tuple[str, str]¶

Wait until the GradCafe applicant results table is available.

src.scrape.load_data(filename: Path = PosixPath('applicant_data.json')) → list[dict]¶

Load previously saved applicant records.

src.scrape.load_state() → dict | None¶

Load the previous restart point.

src.scrape.main() → None¶
src.scrape.merge_data(existing: list[dict], new_records: list[dict]) → int¶

Add new applicants without duplicating applicant URLs.

src.scrape.save_data(data: list[dict], filename: Path = PosixPath('applicant_data.json')) → None¶

Save applicant records as valid JSON.

src.scrape.save_raw_html(html: str, page_number: int) → None¶

Save temporary raw HTML outside the Git repository.

src.scrape.save_state(next_url: str | None, total_records: int, page_number: int) → None¶

Save a restart point outside the Git repository.

SQL Queries¶

src.query_data.main()¶

Run and display all query results.

src.query_data.question_1()¶

Count applicants who applied for Fall 2026.

src.query_data.question_10()¶

Calculate the percentage of Fall 2026 entries that are acceptances.

src.query_data.question_11()¶

Calculate the average GPA of international Fall 2026 applicants.

src.query_data.question_2()¶

Calculate the percentage of classified applicants who are international.

src.query_data.question_3()¶

Calculate average GPA and GRE scores separately.

src.query_data.question_4()¶

Calculate the average GPA of American Fall 2026 applicants.

src.query_data.question_5()¶

Calculate the percentage of Fall 2025 entries that are acceptances.

src.query_data.question_6()¶

Calculate the average GPA of accepted Fall 2026 applicants.

src.query_data.question_7()¶

Count master’s applicants in Computer Science at Johns Hopkins.

src.query_data.question_8()¶

Count accepted Fall 2026 CS PhD applicants using original fields.

src.query_data.question_9()¶

Repeat Question 8 using LLM-generated program and university fields.
